name: Engineering Labs
summary: In Gnomeregan, the Engineering Labs lie in ruin across tiers linked to the Workshop Entrance and Launch Bay. Once a center of gnome invention, they fell in the city's radioactive catastrophe. Crazed leper gnomes and rogue machines now fill the chambers.

sections.title: A Fallen Center of Innovation
sections.body: The Engineering Labs once held Gnomeregan's work in invention. A central mechanical structure rises through two tiers, joined by a cargo lift. At the city's height, tinkerers made schematics and refined clockwork devices here. Radiation drove the remaining researchers mad. Now deranged leper gnomes guard the malfunctioning machinery beside rogue constructs.

sections.title: Crucial Junction
sections.body: The Engineering Labs connect routes through Gnomeregan's lower reaches. Passages lead toward the Launch Bay, Tinkers' Court and the Workshop Entrance back door. On the lower floor, Matrix Punchograph 3005-D terminals process coded punch cards carried by gnome engineers.

faq.q: What were the Engineering Labs originally used for?
faq.answer: Before Gnomeregan fell, engineers researched, assembled and tested complex contraptions and automated devices in the Engineering Labs. Technicians used the vast two-level chamber to blueprint new technology.

faq.q: What threats roam the Engineering Labs now?
faq.answer: Irradiated leper gnomes and haywire mechanical automatons roam both tiers. Gas released during the city's fall drove the lingering residents mad, and they attack any non-irradiated intruders on sight.

faq.q: What are the Matrix Punchograph 3005-D machines?
faq.answer: Matrix Punchograph 3005-D machines are automated data terminals on the Engineering Labs' lower level. Engineers and adventurers use them to punch encoded data cards, advance their security clearance and decipher technical archives preserved within the city.

faq.q: How does this area connect to the rest of Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: The upper level connects to the Workshop Entrance back door and passages toward the Launch Bay. The lower level leads to main corridors linking the Launch Bay and Tinkers' Court.

angles.text: In the Engineering Labs, functional punchograph terminals and discarded schematics reveal the height of gnomish automation before the city's fall.
As an exiled gnome, you see a tragic ruin. These laboratories once held the heart of your people's technological triumphs. Now irradiated ruins are overrun by your corrupted kin.
